# apollo Provider

Manage Apollo GraphOS control-plane configuration through Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "apollo" {
  api_key = var.apollo_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) GraphOS API key. Can also be set with the `APOLLO_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) GraphOS Platform API endpoint. Can also be set with the `APOLLO_GRAPHOS_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
